merchant/30230-pk.htm.text: Trader Edroc: You must leave this place immediately. There are far too many Bounty Hunters around here... If you are discovered you will be killed instantly!

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30230-01.html.text: Trader Edroc: Ah, a letter from Dieter! Dieter the crybaby! Of course I remember him! Did you say that he became a teacher at the School of Wizardry? Oh, my! He did better than I expected he would... He used to cry like a baby after being scolded by Cronos the wise, and I always had to cheer him up…

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30230-03.html.text: Trader Edroc: What did you do with the envelope? I hope Dieter finds the book soon so that he will stop crying. Oh, yes, I remember... You said he is a good teacher now. Ha ha!
